eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 37 to 42 weeks of gestation
* Planned cesarean section

Exclusion Criteria:

* Women with pre-eclampsia
* Chronic hypertension
* Multiple pregnancies
* Preterm or postdate pregnancy
* Previous cesarean section
* Gestational diabetes
* Fetal macrosomia
* History of bleeding / clotting disorder
* On anti-coagulation heparin / warfarin therapy
* Non-reassuring cardiotocograph or poor progress of labor
